name: 2025-26 Official Home Jersey
description: The official MPL home jersey for the 2025-26 season. Lightweight performance fabric with embroidered league crest. Available in all ten club colours.

name: 2025-26 Official Away Jersey
description: The alternate match jersey for the 2025-26 campaign. Breathable mesh construction with contrast detailing. Available for all clubs.

name: MPL Training Top
description: Quarter-zip training top in league navy with green accent trim. Moisture-wicking fabric, raglan sleeves, embroidered MPL crest.

name: Club Supporter Scarf
description: Jacquard-knit scarf in your club's colours. Double-sided design with club name and crest. 100% acrylic, one size fits all.

name: MPL Snapback Cap
description: Structured six-panel snapback cap with embroidered MPL logo. Adjustable fit, curved brim, navy with green under-visor.

name: 2025-26 Official Match Ball
description: The same FIFA-quality ball used in every MPL fixture. Hand-stitched panels, thermal bonding, official league markings. Size 5.

name: MPL Mini Ball
description: Miniature replica of the official match ball. Perfect for display or kickabouts. Size 1 with full league graphics.

name: MPL Travel Mug
description: Insulated stainless steel travel mug with MPL branding. Keeps drinks hot for 6 hours or cold for 12. 450ml capacity.

name: MPL Essential Hoodie
description: Heavyweight cotton-blend hoodie with printed league crest. Kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs, drawstring hood. Available in navy, grey, and green.

name: MPL Matchday Rain Jacket
description: Waterproof, breathable rain jacket for the terraces. Sealed seams, packable hood, reflective MPL badge. Be ready for any weather.

name: Youth Home Kit Set
description: Complete youth kit set including jersey, shorts, and socks. Same design as the senior kit, sized for ages 6-14. Available for all clubs.

name: Club Pennant
description: Traditional triangular pennant featuring your club's crest and founding year. Satin fabric with gold fringe. Perfect for display.
